# INV-61 Distributed WIT RPC — Requirements Specification

**Spec version:** RS-4.3.0 · **Component version:** 4.3.0 · **Status:** Draft for approval (see ADR-0001)
**Normative language:** MUST / MUST NOT / SHOULD / MAY per RFC 2119. Requirement IDs are stable; retired IDs are never reused.
**Traceability:** every checklist control C001–C100 maps to one or more RQ IDs in `TRACEABILITY.json` (generated by `tools/build_traceability.py`, enforced by `tests/test_traceability.py`).

## 1. Function and scope

| ID | Requirement | Controls |
|---|---|---|
| RQ-001 | INV-61 MUST carry typed WIT interface calls between components on different hosts as `PK_WRPC_FRAME/2` frames over an authenticated channel. | C001, C011 |
| RQ-002 | INV-61 MUST own frame format, signature fingerprinting, receiver-side compatibility checks, typed error returns and deadlines, and MUST NOT own interface definitions, service discovery, load balancing or component logic. | C002, C008 |
| RQ-003 | The receiver's WIT signature is the source of truth; a frame MUST be accepted only when its fingerprint equals the receiver's fingerprint for that function. | C004 |
| RQ-004 | Mandatory capabilities (framing, fingerprint check, typed errors, deadlines, authn, authz, replay defence, admission) MUST NOT be disableable by configuration; batching and per-tenant tuning MAY be. | C007 |
| RQ-005 | The same code path MUST be used whether the peer is local (loopback) or remote. | C005, C012 |

## 2. Wire protocol and contracts

| ID | Requirement | Controls |
|---|---|---|
| RQ-010 | WIT sources MUST parse under the pinned subset `inv61-wit-subset/1`; unsupported constructs MUST be rejected, never ignored. | C021, C022, C031 |
| RQ-011 | Values MUST be encoded with the canonical codec (one byte sequence per value; NaN canonicalised; strict UTF-8; range-checked integers). | C022 |
| RQ-012 | Decoders MUST reject trailing bytes, unknown tags, oversize collections/strings, and nesting deeper than `max_depth`, with a stable reason code. | C026, C028 |
| RQ-013 | The frame header length MUST be validated against `max_frame_bytes` before any body allocation. | C028, C067 |
| RQ-014 | Peers MUST negotiate the highest common `(major, minor)` ≥ both minimums; no common version MUST fail the handshake. | C016, C027 |
| RQ-015 | The negotiation transcript MUST be MAC-protected so version downgrade by an on-path party is detected. | C016, C050 |
| RQ-016 | Every error MUST be one of the typed statuses in §6, carry a `retryable` flag, and MUST NOT disclose callee exception types or secrets. | C014, C026 |

## 3. Security

| ID | Requirement | Controls |
|---|---|---|
| RQ-020 | Production deployments MUST use TLS ≥ 1.3 with mutual certificate authentication (`require_tls=true`). | C023, C047 |
| RQ-021 | Every request MUST carry an HMAC-SHA256 envelope MAC under a ring key bound to the sending principal; when TLS is used the certificate CN MUST equal that principal. | C023, C044 |
| RQ-022 | Keys MUST be ≥ 256 bits, carry validity windows, support overlapping rotation and immediate revocation. | C047 |
| RQ-023 | Requests MUST carry a ≥128-bit nonce and an issue time; reused `(sender, nonce)` pairs and requests outside the skew window MUST be refused. The replay cache MUST be bounded and fail closed when full. | C041, C050 |
| RQ-024 | Authorization MUST be default-deny; explicit denies MUST override grants; grants MUST be scoped by principal, tenant, interface and function and MAY expire. | C024, C042, C046 |
| RQ-025 | Unauthenticated requests MUST NOT reach interface lookup, argument decoding or dispatch. | C043, C044 |
| RQ-026 | Authentication failures, authorization denials, replays, version drift, signature mismatch, fence rejections, negotiation failures, emergency disable/enable, and configuration activation MUST be written to the HMAC-chained audit log. | C049, C076 |
| RQ-027 | When identity, key or time services are unavailable the node MUST fail closed (refuse requests), never fail open. | C048 |
| RQ-028 | Release artifacts MUST ship with SHA-256 checksums, a CycloneDX SBOM and a provenance statement; installation MUST verify checksums. | C045 |

## 4. Resilience

| ID | Requirement | Controls |
|---|---|---|
| RQ-030 | Every call MUST have an absolute deadline; a call at or after its deadline MUST NOT start, and a running call MUST be abandoned with `deadline-exceeded` when its deadline passes. | C025 |
| RQ-031 | Cancellation MUST propagate from caller to callee via `CANCEL` frames and a cancellation token. | C025 |
| RQ-032 | Only calls carrying an idempotency key MAY be retried automatically; retries MUST use full-jitter exponential backoff bounded by the remaining deadline. | C025, C053 |
| RQ-033 | A duplicate idempotency key MUST return the cached result without re-execution; the same key with different arguments MUST be refused. Cached results MUST survive restart. | C057, C058 |
| RQ-034 | Admission MUST enforce global and per-tenant in-flight ceilings and per-tenant token buckets and MUST shed with a retryable status. | C017, C054 |
| RQ-035 | Each function MUST have a circuit breaker (closed/open/half-open with a single probe). | C054 |
| RQ-036 | Mutating functions MUST run only on the current lease holder with a fencing epoch not lower than any previously observed. | C055, C058 |
| RQ-037 | Operators MUST be able to emergency-disable a node; the disable flag MUST persist across restart. | C059, C092 |
| RQ-038 | Graceful drain MUST stop accepting connections, refuse new calls with `draining`, and wait for in-flight calls. | C015, C038 |
| RQ-039 | With intermittent connectivity, clients MUST surface ambiguous completion (`unavailable`, `ambiguous=true`) and MUST NOT replay non-idempotent calls. | C018 |

## 5. Configuration, observability, operations

| ID | Requirement | Controls |
|---|---|---|
| RQ-040 | Configuration MUST validate against `inv61-config/1` before activation; unknown keys, out-of-range values and literal secrets MUST be rejected. | C033, C034, C039 |
| RQ-041 | Configuration layers (defaults → base → environment → site) MUST be applied without rebuilding artifacts; immutable keys MUST NOT change at runtime. | C032, C035 |
| RQ-042 | Activation MUST be atomic and produce a provenance record (source digests, merged digest, actor, time, generation); rollback MUST restore the previous generation. | C036, C037, C038 |
| RQ-043 | Nodes MUST expose liveness (stall detection), readiness (dependencies, drain, disable), version, config digest and capability list. | C052, C071 |
| RQ-044 | Nodes MUST export request rate, status, latency histograms, in-flight, connection and shedding metrics with a hard series cap. | C072, C075 |
| RQ-045 | Logs MUST be JSON (`inv61-log/1`) carrying node, component, event and decision reason, with mandatory redaction of secrets, MACs, nonces, args and results. | C073, C075 |
| RQ-046 | W3C `traceparent` MUST be propagated; invalid context MUST start a new trace; span attributes MUST be allow-listed. | C074, C078 |
| RQ-047 | Telemetry retention, sampling, privacy and export MUST follow `docs/TELEMETRY_POLICY.md`. | C079 |

## 6. Status taxonomy (PK_WRPC_ERROR/2)

Terminal: `malformed-frame`, `unauthenticated`, `permission-denied`, `replay`, `version-mismatch`, `signature-mismatch`, `unknown-interface`, `unknown-function`, `invalid-args`, `deadline-exceeded`, `callee-trap`, `cancelled`, `disabled`, `fenced`, `idempotency-conflict`, `internal`.
Retryable: `overloaded`, `rate-limited`, `circuit-open`, `unavailable`, `draining`.
Success: `ok` (detail `idempotent-replay` when served from the idempotency cache).
Partial success is not defined for a single call; batch semantics are out of scope for 4.3.0.

## 7. Precedence when requirements conflict (C019)

1. Security and tenant isolation (RQ-02x) override everything.
2. Data residency and site boundaries override availability.
3. Correctness/no-duplicate-execution (RQ-033, RQ-036) override latency SLOs.
4. Latency and throughput SLOs override cost.
A conflict resolved below rank 1 MUST be recorded in `WAIVERS.md`.

## 8. Non-functional targets (C013)

| Target | Value | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Frame codec+pipeline p99 overhead (in-process) | < 50 µs excluding callee | `evidence/bench_results.json` |
| Availability | 99.9 % monthly per site | SLO in `docs/OPERATIONS.md` (production measurement pending) |
| Max frame | 1 MiB default, 16 MiB hard ceiling | `config.SCHEMA` |
| Durability of idempotency results | survives process restart | `test_restart_preserves_idempotency_disable_and_epoch` |
